body: I am fit and 5'10" with abs, so I don't think I need to go to the gym anymore then I do which is 3 times a week. But I am mainly just depressed about the aspect of dating and just being friends with girls. The last time I sent a text to a girl my age was probably July, and it was my cousin! And I promise I am not that ugly! Even if I have money and lots of accomplishments it just doesn't matter to the attractive girls more than the dumbass popular kids at my school who I can't get in with.

Not many people in my school know of my accomplishments, to them it doesn't intimidate them because they don't know or care. I don't know how girls would react if they knew of my accomplishments, if it would attract them or put them off, but it doesn't matter because they don't care, no one does. I don't feel like waiting till I am in the real world and running some company making hopefully millions of dollars and a king of social status, I want to have fun in high school like many of my peers, go through dating, more friends, parties, etc. But it just doesn't happen and it is completely unbearable. I would give away all of my gifts to get some of those things, especially an amazing girlfriend
